title: Britain peak power demand (from BBC TV series: Britain from Above)
summary: A clip from the BBC series Britain from Above showing UK peak power demand. It shows a grid engineer preparing for the surge as millions put the kettle on when a popular show ends.
why: HN cites it as the canonical illustration of TV pickup and grid balancing, and as a must-see example of demand spikes.

quote.text: Here's a great movie illustrating how the grid is balanced
